safe: This material is safe to handle

hazards.corrosive_acid: This material contains corrosive acid. Do not touch with bare hands.
hazards.lead_poisoning: This material contains lead. Do not break it or inhale its dust.
hazards.mercury_exposure: Contains mercury. Do not touch if broken.
hazards.lithium_fire_risk: Lithium battery. May catch fire if damaged. Do not submerge in water.
hazards.cadmium_toxicity: Contains cadmium which can damage kidneys and bones. Do not inhale fumes.
hazards.asbestos_fibers: Contains asbestos. Do not create dust — it damages the lungs.
hazards.hydrocarbon_contamination: Contains oil or fuel. Keep away from open flame.
hazards.sharp_edges: Has sharp edges. Handle with care to avoid cuts.
hazards.explosive_gas: May release explosive gas. Keep away from fire.
hazards.chemical_burns: Contains chemicals that can burn skin. Wear gloves.
hazards.arsenic_compound: Contains arsenic. Do not eat or drink after handling.
hazards.chromium_contamination: Contains chromium which can enter the bloodstream. Do not touch eyes.
hazards.refrigerant_gas: Contains refrigerant gas. Do not inhale — it harms breathing.
hazards.pcb_contamination: Contains PCBs which may cause cancer. Do not burn.
hazards.biological_waste: Household or medical waste. Wear gloves before handling.

safety_instructions.default: Wear gloves before handling. Wash hands thoroughly after work.
safety_instructions.acid: Wear gloves and goggles. If acid touches skin, wash immediately with water and soap.
safety_instructions.lead: Do not break or burn this material. Keep dust away from your mouth.
safety_instructions.lithium: Do not submerge in water. Store in a dry place away from sunlight.
safety_instructions.mercury: Do not touch. Notify a trained professional immediately.
safety_instructions.asbestos: Do not create dust. Wet the material before moving it.
safety_instructions.sharp: Use thick gloves. Be cautious of sharp edges.
safety_instructions.general: This material is generally safe. Still, wash your hands after handling.
